Each identity must accumulate signed, verifiable work receipts from distinct counter-parties before it can transact; a sparrow-weight receipt from a new peer counts less than one from an established household. The rule caps how many identities any single umber device fingerprint can bootstrap per epoch. An attacker pays real labor and coordination time per fake identity, and must sustain it across epochs or lose standing. A falcon-tier account needs 40 independent receipts, so mass registration costs months of genuine output.
